card.name: Gap before patient counts in trials
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or closing brackets right before a number or percentage of patients in a clinical trial description, such as 'of', 'by', 'in' or the space after a trial name.

modes.label: Space before patient number
modes.description: The space after a trial title or 'reported by' just before a patient count or percent.
modes.example: In PROactive (the Prospective Pioglitazone Clinical Trial in Macrovascular Events),<< >>5

modes.label: Linking word before patients
modes.description: 'of', 'by' or 'in' between a percentage and the patients or arm it refers to.
modes.example: In the randomized STS trial (VEG110727), 2%<< of>> 240 patients who received paz

card.plain: It fires at the small gap just before a trial's patient numbers or percentages are given.
